_policy: L14-FRONTEND-DEPENDENCY-SEC-001. An entry suppresses a blocking frontend advisory ONLY when approval_status is APPROVED, approved_by names the approving founder/security owner, owner is set, and expires is a date no more than 90 days ahead. Unapproved or expired entries are ignored (the advisory keeps blocking). Required fields: id, app, package, advisory (GHSA id or npm advisory source id), owner, expires, approval_status, approved_by, runtime_exposure, compensating_controls, remediation_plan. See docs/security/DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_EXCEPTIONS.md.

exceptions.renewal: Requires separate founder approval; this record must not be extended in place.
exceptions.dependency_paths: node_modules/picomatch@2.3.2 (tailwindcss > micromatch; tailwindcss > fast-glob > micromatch; eslint-config-next > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch) and node_modules/tinyglobby/node_modules/picomatch@4.0.4 (tailwindcss > sucrase > tinyglobby [> fdir]; eslint-config-next > @typescript-eslint/* and eslint-import-resolver-typescript > tinyglobby). Every lockfile entry is dev-only and reachable only from devDependencies roots.
exceptions.runtime_exposure: None in production. Both lockfile copies are flagged dev; npm ls --omit=dev lists no picomatch; no application source imports picomatch or any glob library; the production server traces (.nft.json, and the Console .next/standalone image) contain no copy of the affected npm packages. The trigger requires an attacker-supplied glob PATTERN (e.g. +(*)); the only patterns reaching these tools are repository config (tailwind content globs, ESLint and TypeScript config).
exceptions.compensating_controls: Affected tooling runs only at lint/build/dev time on repository-controlled patterns; PR code that could alter patterns can already execute arbitrary code in its own CI job, so no privilege is gained; the exception is scoped to this exact app, package and advisory, every other critical/high finding and any AUDIT_UNVERIFIED result still fails the gate; auto-expires in 30 days.
exceptions.remediation_plan: Track upstream micromatch/picomatch PR #194 and new releases. When a patched picomatch is published for the 4.x line (tinyglobby) and for the 2.x line or a micromatch/anymatch release that moves off it, update the lockfiles, confirm make frontend-audit passes with this entry removed, and delete the entry in the same PR. If not patched by 2026-12-17, the gate blocks again; renewal needs separate founder approval.
